facts.fact: SERAP says the 2024 amendment of the Cybercrimes Act retains ambiguous cyberstalking wording in section 24; the article gives no date for the briefing, so its published date is used.

SERAP says authorities continue to use section 24 to arrest and charge journalists, bloggers, activists and ordinary citizens, including over posts in WhatsApp alumni groups; no individual case or date is given, so the published date is used.
